title: Language file frontmatter
description: Machine fields in the YAML frontmatter of languages/<lang>.md. The Markdown body below the frontmatter is prose the writer prompt reads verbatim and is not described here.

language.description: Canonical language name. Matches detect_language.py output.

extensions.description: Source file extensions this language claims, leading dot included.

artifacts.description: Doc types to request per module kind. Keys are the kinds classify_modules.py emits; library is the fallback for an unrecognised kind.

reference_generator.description: Native reference generator to defer to. Omit when the language has none worth deferring to.

command.description: Shell command with {name} placeholders filled by generator_command().

produces.description: Which doc type the generator covers, so docs-write stops producing it.

doc_comment.description: In-source doc comment convention. writable stays false by default: writing doc comments means a pull request against code, a different review and risk class than a docs PR.

docs_dir.description: Conventional documentation directory for this language, used when .docs-gen.yaml does not set docs_dir.

test_globs.description: Where usage evidence lives. docs-write reads matching files as example sources.
